messages:
sam: Morning — quick release-train check. Cut window is 15:00 UTC today. Cherry queue shows 3 pending picks. Main blocker: packaging tests failing on `model-packager-v2` (CUDA memcheck / OOM). If packaging doesn't green up, canary won't start. Please post PR links/statuses and any ETA.
jess: Which PRs are we talking about? paste links pls.
ben: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421 (packager fix), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3423 (docs/backport), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3425 (quantize tweak). 3421 is the packaging fix but CI is flaking on lint in one job.
kai: I retried the packaging job twice — logs show OOM at seq_len=4096 in the quantize step. Reducing batch to 1 allowed the job to finish locally. Pushing a patch to throttle batch size for that pipeline, should be up in ~20m.
maria: Canary capacity note: dedicated pool currently has 2 fewer GPUs (infra swap delayed). Eng-infra told me swap ETA ~30m. If packaging blocks beyond that, we should plan fallback to stable model variant to avoid user impact. @sam ok with auto-fallback?
sam: Yes. Fallback plan: if canary isn't healthy by 15:20 UTC, roll back traffic to model v1.9 and open a rollback incident. Also hold cut if any cherry still has >1 pending approvals.
kai: pushed patch and force-pushed a trimmed quantize step — commit abc123 (sha: abc123def). PR 3425 updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3425. Requesting reviews from @jess and @ben.
jess: Taking a look now. small nits but nothing blocking. will re-run the lint job locally and push a tiny fix if needed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued for commit abc123def — canary request received. Status: queued (workflow/infra).
ben: I'll nudge infra on the GPU swap and watch the CI runs. Tagging @infra-oncall.
infra-oncall: Got the ping. Accelerating the node swap, aiming to finish in ~18 minutes. Will update here when pool is back to normal.
maria: QA smoke against staging looked fine for API surface. No regressions in top-10 prompts. If canary starts, please run `smoke/api-run` after route changes.
sam: Thanks all — small checklist before cut: 1) all cherry PRs approved, 2) packaging CI green, 3) canary healthy or fallback decided. If any of these fail by 15:20 UTC I will hold the cut and announce.
ben: FYI command to watch rollout: ```kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-canary -n prod --timeout=5m```
jess: LGTM on 3425 after I push lint fix. Approving once CI turns green.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for abc123def -> redwood-canary. Status: running (0/3 pods ready).
sam: Copy. I'll monitor and call rollback if it doesn't stabilize by 15:20.
